meta.schema_note: One record per pf- geo_id. rings holds simplified exterior polygon rings as [lon, lat] pairs, Douglas-Peucker at 0.02 degrees, parts below 0.002 square degrees dropped, holes dropped. Metropolitan and City of London Police are merged into pf-london. For the static national choropleth only; not for geographic analysis.
meta.source: ONS Open Geography portal, Police Force Areas (December 2023), generalised clipped boundaries (BGC)
